connector.name: Greptimedb MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Query and analyze GreptimeDB metrics, logs and traces via SQL, TQL and RANGE queries.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package greptimedb-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the greptimeteam account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GREPTIMEDB_HTTP_PORT
env.description: HTTP API port for pipeline management (default: 4000)

env.name: GREPTIMEDB_HTTP_PROTOCOL
env.description: HTTP protocol for pipeline API: http or https (default: http)

env.name: GREPTIMEDB_MASK_PATTERNS
env.description: Additional column name patterns for data masking (comma-separated)

env.name: GREPTIMEDB_AUDIT_ENABLED
env.description: Enable audit logging for tool invocations (default: true)
